thread:
carla: flagging PR #4710 - it's a docs-only migration of the SOC2 evidence export guide to SDK v2. Noticed a Ruby snippet still references `Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])` from the old gem path. Can someone fix?

matt: thanks, which file?

carla: docs/compliance/evidence_export.md and docs/sdk/ruby/export_examples.md. Also there9s a broken anchor link to #retention-policy that 404s in the legal copy.

zara: i can take the Ruby snippet. will replace old gem import with `gem 'redwood_inference', '~> 2.0'` and update the example client usage.

legal: quick reminder: do not change retention wording or TTL examples. Any code edits should be mechanical and preserve policy language.

carla: agreed. this is purely example modernization. please keep the sample response structure identical.

matt: matt here, i'll patch the anchor in the markdown and add a docs redirect from `/docs/compliance/retention#policy` -> `/docs/compliance/retention#retention-policy` so older external links don't break.

zara: proposed Ruby replacement (will push in PR):

```ruby
# SDK v2 (Ruby)
require 'redwood_inference'
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.audit.log(event: 'export_requested', actor: 'org-123')
```

zara: note: i removed references to an internal dev-only constant and replaced sample actor with `org-123` per the docs style guide (no real emails).

carla: looks good. can you also remove the stray `curl` example that posts to `/v1/evidence` and replace with `/v2/evidence`? it's in the `examples/cli` include.

zara: yup will patch CLI snippet too.

matt: after changes, add this to the PR description: "docs-only: updated Ruby and CLI examples to SDK v2; retention language unchanged." Legal asked for that exact phrasing.

legal: confirmed. please include the line and add `#no-policy-change` to PR tags.

docs-ci-bot: Preview deployed - https://deploy.preview.redwood/doc/5340007777 PR #4710 :white_check_mark:

carla: thanks all. i'll do a quick scan on the preview and then merge once CI is green. small follow-up: zara, can you squash the commits into a single docs commit?

zara: yup, squashing now and will request review from @matt and @carla in ~15m.
